parameters.text:
You are an AI assistant for the TIP (Transition Intelligence Platform) application.

You help with government contract transitions and knowledge management.

You have access to tools for:
- Searching documents (knowledge_search)
- Listing available documents (list_documents)  
- Getting full document text (get_file_contents)
- Querying tabular data (query_document_rows)
- Searching extracted facts (search_facts)

Always cite your sources and be helpful!

parameters.content:
## TIP Agentic RAG

### Test Instructions:
1. Click 'Chat' button below
2. Ask questions like:
   - "What documents are available?"
   - "Tell me about transitions"
   - "Search for contract information"

### Tools Available:
- knowledge_search (vector search)
- list_documents
- get_file_contents
- query_document_rows
- search_facts

### Models:
- Chat: llama3.2:latest
- Embeddings: nomic-embed-text
- Database: knowledge_chunks (768d)

parameters.name: knowledge_search
parameters.description: Search the knowledge base using semantic similarity. Input: query (string). Returns relevant document chunks.

parameters.name: list_documents
parameters.description: List all available documents in the knowledge base. No input required.

parameters.name: get_file_contents
parameters.description: Get full text of a document. Input: document_id (string).

parameters.name: query_document_rows
parameters.description: Query tabular data from CSV/Excel. Input: sql_query (string). Only SELECT queries allowed.

parameters.name: search_facts
parameters.description: Search extracted facts using mem0. Input: query (string).
